title: The Goblin Den
description: A short demo delve — three chambers, one riddle, one nap. Proves every room dynamic.
premise: The player is a traveler who ducked into a hillside cave to escape a storm and found goblin tunnels instead. Somewhere below, the goblins hoard a moonstone amulet. Get it, get out.
dm_guide: Lamplit adventure, a little wry. Goblins are dangerous the way weather is — respect, not horror. Make searching feel rewarding, and when the riddle stalls, let the runes glimmer over their carvings.
